publication_timeout.rule: Only a correlated fault naming one of outer outcome publication, final enforcement publication, workload publication, workload-publication establishes a publication timeout.
publication_timeout.note: NOT ESTABLISHED, and for an absent outer report NOT ESTABLISHABLE. No correlated fault naming a publication step was read. An absent or inaccessible report is not evidence of a timeout: a run that never started, an import or startup failure (see FAILURE.md), process death, a failed read and non-timeout publication errors all leave no final report.

result.acceptance: A missing or partial final report is INCOMPLETE: never success, never acceptance and never proof of cessation. No startup success and no producer exit substitutes for final-result acceptance. An unavailable report retracts nothing already recorded, and one unreadable artifact does not invalidate the others.
result.owner: the external operator and the independent reviewer. The worker inside the run cannot observe any of these artifacts; its own report covers what it saw before termination plus the retained candidate checkpoint -- see TASK.md item 6.
